name: manual_74187a
claim: Trace a freeze or hold to its source before obeying or ignoring it: an agent's standing note about merges is advice, while your own posted commitment (push only after the reviews and the operator's decision) is the binding constraint; ask the operator rather than inferring consent from 'continue'.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: an auditor's note said not to push until the reviews and the operator's decisions; it matched what had already been committed on the board, and the decision was put to the operator.
